cinder_pit.label: Cinder Pit
cinder_pit.intro: Coals glow under the sand. Ember arts burn hotter, Bloom arts wither, and nothing stays wet.

cinder_heart.label: Cinder Heart
cinder_heart.text: The pit coughs up a heart of coals. It remembers who threw it in.

phase.text: The Cinder Heart stokes itself white-hot!
